Without hesitation, she names Russia, China, and Iran, saying that there is “only one man” those countries are afraid of: Donald Trump. She then explains that her opinion comes from decades of watching American presidents. She says she is in her eighties and has followed presidents going back to Franklin D. Roosevelt, giving her a long personal perspective on American politics and presidential leadership. The woman says Trump stands out because, in her view, he did what he said he was going to do. She argues that Trump was different from other presidents she has watched because she believes he followed through on the commitments he made to voters. She emphasizes that point again, saying she has never seen another president do the same thing. Her comments reflect her strong personal support for Trump and her belief that his approach to leadership was different from what she had witnessed throughout her lifetime. The conversation then turns toward younger generations and their understanding of America's position in the world. The woman questions whether younger people fully appreciate the difference between presidents and ends by returning to her belief that major foreign powers, including China, feared a Trump administration. #DonaldTrump #China #USPolitics #AmericanPolitics
